provincial.name: Community Bus Pass Program
provincial.who: Employment support and income assistance clients plus spouses and children (CBRM kids 5-21; HRM kids 13-21 not in Student Transit Pass); Disability Support Program participants in HRM or CBRM
provincial.what: Free annual bus pass; free ride without pass under 5 (CBRM) / 12 and under (HRM)
provincial.route: Photo visit at OSD office (CBRM: Glace Bay, North Sydney, Sydney; HRM: Cole Harbour, Dartmouth, Halifax, Lower Sackville), pass mailed; caseworker or 1-877-424-1177
provincial.notes: Cape Breton launched Nov 2025 per search (news.novascotia.ca/en/2025/11/04/community-bus-pass-program-launching-cape-breton, not fetched). Only HRM and CBRM.

provincial.name: Caregiver Benefit
provincial.who: Caregiver 19+ giving 20+ hrs/week unpaid; care recipient 19+ with income in home care category A and assessed as high disability by NSHA care coordinator
provincial.notes: Home care income category A is the gate for several programs.

provincial.name: Public Housing (NSPHA) eligibility
provincial.who: Gross household income below CMHC-based limits for area/bedrooms; citizen or PR; NS resident; able to live independently
provincial.what: Rent-geared-to-income public housing: 25% of income for households with adult+dependent, 30% for most others
provincial.route: Online Applicant Portal or any District Office (Metro, Western, Northern, Cape Breton); SIN and proof of residency
provincial.notes: Priority access needs signed professional referral. Search says age 19+ (18 with dependents) and seniors housing 58+ (not fetched).
